name: Moscow Peace Treaty Ends the Winter War
summary: WWII: Finland cedes territory to the Soviet Union but preserves independence after fierce resistance.

name: Germany Invades Denmark and Norway
summary: WWII: Germany launches Operation Weserubung to secure Scandinavia and protect iron ore routes.

name: Germany Invades the Low Countries
summary: WWII: German forces invade Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg as part of the campaign in the West.

name: Dunkirk Evacuation
summary: WWII: British, French, and other Allied troops are evacuated from Dunkirk under German pressure.

name: Italy Enters World War II
summary: WWII: Mussolini declares war on Britain and France as France nears defeat.

name: Paris Falls
summary: WWII: German troops enter Paris during the Fall of France.

name: French Armistice with Germany
summary: WWII: France signs an armistice with Germany, dividing the country between occupation and the Vichy regime.

name: Battle of Britain Begins
summary: WWII: The Luftwaffe begins a major air campaign against Britain, seeking air superiority before any invasion.

name: The Blitz
summary: WWII: Germany begins sustained bombing of London and other British cities.

name: Tripartite Pact
summary: WWII: Germany, Italy, and Japan sign the Tripartite Pact, formalizing the Axis alliance.
